queries.question: Which primary papers on affine arithmetic and interval dependency explain how to preserve repeated occurrences of the same uncertain variable when evaluating affine expressions, and how dependency differs from treating separate intervals independently? In particular, identify the original de Figueiredo and Stolfi work and author-hosted full papers.

queries.question: How do Jorge Stolfi and Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo's original 2003 paper 'An Introduction to Affine Arithmetic' and their 2004 paper 'Affine Arithmetic: Concepts and Applications' define shared noise symbols and exact affine operations to handle repeated-variable interval dependency?
Author-hosted original paper Affine arithmetic concepts and applications Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo Jorge Stolfi 2004 interval dependency cancellation PDF
Find the author-hosted journal full paper Affine arithmetic: concepts and applications on lhf.impa.br or ic.unicamp.br, by de Figueiredo and Stolfi, 2004, rather than oral presentation slides.
